operation: Reset -> PrimePromptPrefix(prefix of M tokens) -> ForwardToken(next prompt token, returnLogits=true)
purpose: Full base-model prefill plus next logits: raw versus same-size packed82 IQ2 storage, otherwise identical current GUI routes
scope: No LoRA adapter and no vision encoder. Only InferencePackedIq2Decode differs; current row-major BSLM, batched text attention and split output head are enabled for both. Per-kernel profiling disabled to measure GUI wall latency. Prefix checkpoint capture and final logits download included in wall time.

timing.prefixReuse: Reset before every operation; PrimePromptPrefix must report 0 reused tokens
timing.order: One original model session then one candidate session; never loaded concurrently
timing.gpuMetric: Not measured; GPU time, GPU speedup and kernel-coverage fields are null. Validate the selected route with separate profiled evidence.
timing.hostMetric: Reset through blocking final logits readback; excludes comparison, serialization, file hashing
timing.phaseMetric: Contiguous host intervals for Reset, PrimePromptPrefix and the final ForwardToken; their sum equals wall time. No additional phase synchronization is inserted.

numericGate.note: Full vocabulary logit L2 gate is distinct from projection microbenchmark tolerances; changed FP32 order can propagate through 64 layers.

prompt.seedText: 日本語の説明文です。数値計算では、入力、出力、計算時間、誤差を同じ条件で確認します。データを小さなまとまりに分け、行列の積を順番に求めます。結果を比較して、その理由を簡潔に説明してください。
prompt.construction: Repeat UTF-8 seed within a user ChatML prefix, tokenize, and take exactly M+1 tokens; M tokens are primed and the final token obtains logits
